title: About James Wolfe
body:
James writes on grace, patience, and the ordinary shape of the Christian life. He lives and works in a quiet Midwestern town, publishes on Substack twice monthly, reads often, and is always searching for sticks that might be swords.

## Mission

My mission is to understand our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ, to serve and follow him, to glorify him with my gifts and to make his name great. This site exists to help weary Christians find comfort and confidence in Christ — through writing that brings dignity and assurance to faithful sufferers and weary pilgrims.

## Currently

Writing weekly, working on a first book, and slowly building out a public archive of quotations that have shaped his thinking.
